items.title: Johnny Lala Interview, 1960-03-15
items.q: He came over by Joe Moreson one day. He put a record he said that was him. He couldn't have played it. That's a beautiful pair on that record. But I never knew him to play that way.

ctx.x: I got a kick out of one I bought his Lange band. Yeah, he was a Wofferskid.

He was a bad call. Yeah, it hadn't really gone their own. I went to the Hudson River today. Was he really kicking really? Was he really kicking on his guitar? Charlie Q, I guess so. He was a four string guitar, too.
